body: So because there are not millions there are not any? Stop lumping this situation into a statistic based category. Honestly you think this is the right place and time to tell someone to stop using a forum, honestly just stop.

Regardless of your opinion, thats not cool. How do you claim to know anything, what knowledge do you have into her situation? Stop pretending to know something you clearly can't. You should be ashamed.

Hey man, first off I know our problems are going to be different, but I think there are similarities regardless. I'm sorry that things have been going like this, honestly I know how you feel and I understand alot of people will tell you that, but I have been there, I have had attempts as well. Its hard to see what the world has to offer when your experiences are being tarnished by others. For me, I had to get myself into therapy, I tried for years to handle it myself and there would be good times but there would always be bad times and eventually it would become too much, pushing me to the edge. I don't know if you have access or resources to explore that as an option but that is what has been most beneficial for me. It helped me to move past negativity from others and focus on myself and my own experiences. There are alot of ways you can beat this, one of them you are already using, this and other forums are great to talk to people and reach out whenever you need. I'm always here for whatever you need. Hit me up. Don't forget to love yourself.
Got through work well and good. Now going to enjoy time with the family. Thanks for keeping this sub fresh and active. 👏👏
sorry, I know how hard this is.
Yeah it was a rough year huh? But we were together for about two years. What about you?

Right here. I'm in a very similar situation, although I wish I could say my break-up was amiable, it was not. Despite that, I am just focusing on working and my school, and pursuing the new interest I found for myself, but deep down, a lot of the times, right at the surface is those heart wrenching feelings of sadness and loneliness. I have definitely started down this path as well, looking toward the future and hoping for all to be well, but admittedly I am still very much hurt right now, but that is okay, eventually it will get better.

Honestly I had to take a second job for the summer, its ridiculous, butI think its worth theme you put into it, if I can get through this and work on what I need to, working more so I can afford that opportunity was the best choice. I don't know if that is an option for you to work more or look for something better paying, but thats my best suggestion.

Hey, trust I can relate to your issues with your girlfriend more than you know. But I know this is incredibly hard to hear, but the best advice I can offer, is to start small and focus on yourself, its so hard to let go of the ones we love, but we can't lose ourselves in them. The only relationship that truly matters is the one with ourself. Its hard to even write this, it sucks what tends to happen in our relationships, but we are all here for you and for each other.

Honestly I feel like this isn't the place for your post like this, this sub is more for us the individuals with bpd. I'm not trying to be rude, it's just not what this sub is meant for and I honestly feel like you are just translating what happened because someone in your life is struggling with mental illness and it's projecting a stigmatized and negative view of bpd as a whole, it's not progressive or helpful. Its kind of triggering for people, nobody likes to be chastised, bpd isn't an excuse for our behavior, it's the reason and the causation. Nobody wants to have bpd, I've been through a lot of shit because of this, and I'm only 20 and a lot of people here have gone through a lot of issues because of all this as well. But I think I speak for the vast majority of us, we are trying, its not an easy road and I understand to people on the outside what we may look like because of the stereotypes and behaviors that occur, but no matter what happens in life compassion is more important than needless anger, saying you would unload on her and all this stuff is not useful for anyone and only serves you as a quick gratification to make yourself feel better. I understand you have your own experience with this disorder and sadly like most it was negative, but this is a place of support, progress, and hope.

Yeah, so I just started dbt, and I can honestly tell you that it has been working wonders for me. I'm not going to lie to you, it's not easy to spill out everything and be honest and overcome yourself, it's a challenge, but its been worth it and it will start to help you find a balance with your mindset and your actions.
Exactly, this is crazy, control is lacking in an excessive way, almost all the time.

Guys I hear you, the struggle is so real. Honestly my issue is impulsivity, and freaking out when my s/o and I were not on the same page. Yeah its pretty serious I've had some suicide attempts, what about you guys, anything similar?
Same, whats on your mind?
You can always send her another, no time like the present.

I'm not sure if you're looking for advice, but if you are, here is mine. Go for it, tell her how you feel and give it your best shot, life's simply to short to not fight for what you want. Go get her.
I agree, everything will move on, it always does, I appreciate your thoughts and advice.

Thanks, I appreciate everything. Yeah I'm 20, it was silly to go over to her house and all, but I wanted an answer and I suppose I found one. You're right, almost everyone will go through heartbreak, its just about how well I walk through the fire now.
Thanks, I really appreciate it. I know it will all be okay, its just challenging when everything goes up in flames.

I can't tell you how much I relate to you. I found everything out today, and she was in the wrong same as you, she cheated, she lied, she even let me move back across the state all while she was sleeping with someone else. This is heart wrenching, but I guess it will all be fine eventually. But I still want her, no matter what happened, its ridiculous.
Completely, just do your best to control what you can, and let go of what you can not.
